_validation_note: 14-day window (May 28 – June 11, 2026) produced zero survivors. The window was broadened to 21 days (May 21 – June 11, 2026) per protocol. The broadened window also produced zero survivors. Every serious candidate failed at least one gate as follows. C_F1 (Quintillion Nome-Homer Express FWS Compatibility Determination): Gate 3 fails — Layer 1 (NTIA Middle Mile grant) has no confirmable primary source (GCI press release cites only generic 'grant projects in progress'; ADN article identifies BEAD grants of $48M not NTIA Middle Mile; all broadbandusa.ntia.gov pages return HTTP 403); Gate 2 fails — only two layers have confirmed primary sources, below the 3-layer minimum; Gate 5 fails — 50 CFR 26.41(a)(13-14) requires both Refuge Manager signature and Regional Chief concurrence, two officials, not a single asymmetric chokepoint. C_R1 (FCC Submarine Cable Landing License Second R&O): Gate 5 fails — FCC Commission is a 5-member majority-vote body; Team Telecom reframe also fails Gate 1 because the GCI/Quintillion cable landing license transfer has not yet been filed with FCC (DA-26-393 covers only the GCI Liberty/Malone transaction). C_F2 (Kenai LNG Trans-Foreland FERC CP26-61-000): Gate 1 fails — Federal Register notice May 20 outside 14-day window; Gate 5 fails independently — FERC Commission is 5-member. C_F3 (Cook Inlet LNG FSRU): Gate 2 fails — pre-filing stage only; Gate 5 fails — FERC pre-filing intake is staff-level with no binary single actor. C_V1 (NSF TechAccess Hub NSF 26-508): Gate 3 fails — Layer 3 primary source is an industry marketing page; Gate 5 fails — NSF OTASO National Lead selection has no named individual binary decision-maker. C_V2 (NSF SBIR/STTR Restart): Gate 1 fails — news trigger (grantedai.com) is an industry marketing newsletter, not an independent outlet; Gate 5 fails — NSF Program Officers are anonymous role pool. C_V3 (NSPM-11 DoD AI Procurement Review): Gate 4 fails — no Alaska-specific AI consequence confirmed in any fetched source; Gate 5 fails — procurement rewrite distributed among SecDef, DNI, CDAO, OMB. C_CS1 (AIDEA Revolving Fund ANWR Capital): Gate 3 fails — AS 44.88.060 statute PDF binary-unreadable; Resolution G26-05 PDF binary-unreadable; HB124 citizenportal.ai returns 403; three of five layers unconfirmable; Gate 4 fails — actual investment is in ANWR oil/gas leases, AI consequence is prospective and inferential. C_CS2 (APFC FY27 IPS): Gate 1 fails — trigger is agency's own press release; Gate 4 fails — AI consequence inferential; Gate 5 fails — CIO authority is de facto, not formally established. C_R3 (NRC Part 57 / Eielson Aurora): Gate 1 fails — all trigger articles are outside both windows (Pillsbury May 5, Oklo articles from June 2025). New 21-day candidates: BLM Coastal Plain Lease Sale fails Gate 4 (no AI consequence) and Gate 3 (press release 404); Alaska LNG Tax Break / Glenfarne FID fails Gate 5 (FERC 5-member, legislature majority vote, private FID); AIDEA ANWR Lease Acquisition fails Gate 3 (PDF 404). No mechanism survived both windows with all seven gates intact. This is a correct no-target outcome; the bar was not lowered.
